info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cash Flow Personalization API
info.description: The Cash Flow Personalization API allows businesses to create and manage personalized cash flow scenarios for individual customers. This API enables financial institutions to tailor cash flow assessments based on diverse customer profiles, enhancing their ability to offer customized financial solutions. Typical consumers include financial advisors, banking applications, and other fintech platforms. By leveraging this API, organizations can better understand customer behaviors and preferences, ultimately driving engagement and improving financial decision-making.

post.summary: Create Personal Cash Flow for Customer
post.description: This operation allows you to create a personal cash flow record for a specified customer, providing a comprehensive overview of their financial activities.
